description: Energy consumption in Geographical area is a series of datasets listed in Opendataumea open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Umeå Energi. Anonymiserad förbrukningsdata från Umeå Energi per nyckelkodsområde i Umeå Kommun. Detta data bör inte ses som exakta och kompletta förbrukningsvärden utan mer som en kvalificerad uppskattning av förbrukningen i syfte att se trender och indikationer. Coverage: Umeå. The portal lists 17 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Energy. Its keywords are Energy, Consumption, Electricity, District heating. The portal shows 2,344 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-01-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-umea-se-portal.
